after.name: Question 1
after.worked_solution:
Evaluating the function at $t=3,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}r(3) & =⟨2(3)-4,\,\sqrt{6(3)+7},\,\sqrt{3+4}⟩ \\  & =⟨2,\,5,\,\sqrt{7}⟩.\end{aligned}
$$

Computing the magnitude of this vector, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}|r(3)| & =\sqrt{{(2)}^{2}+{(5)}^{2}+(\sqrt{7})^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{4+25+7} \\  & =\sqrt{36} \\  & =6.\end{aligned}
$$

after.name: Question 2
after.problem: What is the value of $f(t)=2{e}^{t}\,i+\sqrt{t+4}\,j+(t-2)^{4}\,k$ at $t=0?$
after.worked_solution:
To evaluate, we substitute $t=0$ into the function, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(0) & =2{e}^{0}\,i+\sqrt{0+4}\,j+(0-2)^{4}\,k \\  & =2\,i+2\,j+16\,k\end{aligned}
$$

So, the value of $f(t)$ at $t=0$ is the vector $2\,i+2\,j+16\,k.$

after.name: Question 5
after.worked_solution:
Evaluating the function at $t=2,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}r(2) & =⟨cos\,(\frac{2\pi }{2}),\,\sqrt{{2}^{3}-4},\,ln\,(2\,{e}^{0}-1)⟩ \\  & =⟨\operatorname{cos}⁡(\pi ),\,\sqrt{4},\,\operatorname{ln}⁡(1)⟩ \\  & =⟨-1,\,2,\,0⟩.\end{aligned}
$$

Computing the magnitude of this vector, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}|r(2)| & =\sqrt{(-1)^{2}+{2}^{2}+{0}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{1+4+0} \\  & =\sqrt{5}.\end{aligned}
$$
